SPECIAL CONDITIONS OF CONTRACT: 1. Incomer ACB rating in Panel No-1 is revised from 3200A to 2500A. 2. This is an OTE case and hence offers of only the vendors fulfilling the Eligibility criteria attached in the A TC will be considered. Other offers will be rejected. 3. Bidder shall submit the "GUARANTEE/WARRANTY CERTIFICATE." and "TEST CERTIFICATE" to Bokaro Stee l Plant at the time of each lot of material supply. 4. The supplier must replace, free of charge, any stores & spares which owing to defect in design, material or workmanship fail or show signs of failure at any time within 12 months from date of putting them to us e / operation or 18 months from date of delivery, whichever is earlier. During warranty period, new items shall be used for replacement & no additional charges on any account (repair or replacement) shall be payable to the Bidder. 5. In case of dealer or authorized distributors, the GeM bid-specific OEM Authorization certificate is to be su bmitted. 6. Note: - The attached doc in Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC, Buyer Specification Document, and statement of conformity/deviations, Make in India Format, Format of undertaking, notarized affidavit and Annexure S are mandatory for submission along with the bid document, duly sealed & signed. 7. Other Terms and Conditions: i. Unloading responsibility at BSL Stores: BSL ii. Payment Terms: 80 percent payment shall be made to the successful bidder after supply of all the panel s on GRN. Balance 20 percent payment shall be made to the successful bidder after successful commissio ning of all the panels. iii. Supply terms: FOR BSL Stores 8. PERFORMANCE GUARANTEE DEPOSIT: The bidder shall be liable to submit a Bank Guarantee (BG) of 5 % of the value of the PO as Performance Security Deposit (No interest shall be payable on BG submitted for Performance Guarantee). The performance security shall be valid till the end of warranty period (14 month s from the date of commissioning), which will be releasable after the completion of warranty period subject to successful fulfillment of terms and conditions and on receipt of requisite no dues certificate from the co ncerned departments/ authorities. The security deposit is liable to be forfeited if the bidder withdraws or impairs or surrogates the bid in any r espect. 9. Earnest Money may be submitted in the form of Online transfer, Demand Draft, Banker's Cheque, Bank Guarantee (BG) or Fixed Deposit Receipt (FDR) from any Scheduled Commercial Bank except Co-operative and Gramin Bank but shall not be accepted in cash. Micro & Small Enterprises (MSEs) / PSUs / Government Undertakings and Co-operative Societies / Start-ups as recognised by Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) etc., are exempted from submission of EMD as per extant Government policy. For MSEs, the exemption will be extended on the ba sis of : i) Self-certified copy of Udyam Registration Certificate (URC); ii) The concerned MSE is registered in the MSME databank and iii) MSE is registered for the given scope of job / procurement. 10. INSPECTION Plan No: 1 STAGE INSPECTION: waived PREDISPATCH INSPECTION (INDIGENOUS): waived PREDISPATCH INSPECTION (IMPORT): waived FINAL RECEIPT INSPECTION:

RECEIPT INSPECTION 1. VISUAL INSPECTION 2. VERIFIACTION OF DOCS QAP & DOCUMENTS TO BE SUBMITTED: Documents to be submitted: 1.GC INSPECTION TEXT: 1. BSL reserves the right to conduct inspection at any stage prior to despatch or after receipt including tes ting of materials irrespective of inspection clause given in the PO. 2. All test reports / documents mentioned in PO have to be submitted in addition to the documents mentio ned in inspection plan along with the material or whenever asked for. 3. Clear, visible identification mark (IM) of the supplier /manufacturer has to be given on the material and i t has to be encircled, failing which the material may be rejected. The detail of the "IM" & its location on the material has to be clearly mentioned in the invoice/challan/packing list. . 11.
